profile.headline: Software Engineer at Snap Inc.
profile.summary:
I enjoy platforms that connect the world.  Everything we experience through technology was once nothing more than a dream in someone's head.  It is those dreams that are now shaping the world and changing the ways we interact on a day to day basis.

I am primarily an iOS developer with extensive experience in strategically developing, planning, managing, organizing, designing, coding, testing, validating, debugging, and delivering apps.  I have worked with both large and small teams as well as Fortune 500 companies and startups.

Specialties: Xcode, iOS Development, Objective-C, Cocoa/Cocoa Touch, C++, JSON, Java, C#, Git, SVN, OOP, XML, JQuery, SQL/SQLite, HTML5, CSS3, Javascript, Lua, PHP
